Introduction
I am a Mechanical Design & BIM Engineer with over four years of experience designing mechanical systems for residential and commercial developments across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and Jordan.

Currently at Ian Banham & Associates, I work on mechanical design across HVAC, fire protection, and plumbing systems — handling calculations, equipment selection, and layouts. I also contribute to BIM coordination, space planning, and authority submissions throughout the project.

Created Tools

Built to Work Faster.

Revit add-ins and applications I designed and built to take the repetition out of live project delivery — BIM parameter compliance, model QA, equipment scheduling and code reference.

Tool 01
Aldar Classify — Parameter Auto-Fill
Revit Add-In · Aldar Projects
Auto-fills the Uniclass 2015 and NRM1 classification on model elements across the mechanical, electrical, public health and fire fighting disciplines, writing the codes and their descriptions straight into the model and applying them across a whole project in two clicks.
Tool 02
DHRE Assets — Parameter Auto-Fill
Revit Add-In · Dubai Holding Projects
Fills the Dubai Holding asset information on model elements across the mechanical, electrical and public health disciplines, so every item carries the asset data the standard requires. It classifies the whole model against the DHRE asset list, flags anything with no matching rule, and audits the model against the LOD 300 requirements before it goes for review.
Tool 03
Aldar Compliance — Health Report Score
Revit Add-In · Aldar QA / QC
Scores a model against the Aldar checkset and builds a scorecard of what passes and what will fail.
Tool 04
Revit Chat Assistant
Revit Add-In · Productivity
A docked pane inside Revit where you type an instruction in plain language — colour all walls red, tag all ducts — and it happens. The command layer is a hand-written parser with synonym matching and typo tolerance rather than a language model, so it responds instantly, works offline, costs nothing per use, and no model data ever leaves the machine. Revit 2023–2024.
Tool 05
FCU Schedule Generator
Windows Application · Equipment Scheduling
Parses a Carrier HAP System Output report into a formatted fan coil unit schedule with fan motor power calculated per unit, exported as a styled Excel sheet ready for submission. Built to replace a full day of manual transcription on a large residential project.
Tool 06
MEP Codes & Standards
Windows Application · Reference
A searchable reference for the codes an MEP design actually runs on — ASHRAE, NFPA, CIBSE, SMACNA and the UAE and Dubai regulations — with a built-in PDF viewer, clickable page references and a side-by-side compare mode for checking one code against another.
Tool 07
DWG Batch Rename Tool
Web Application · File Automation
Batch renames DWG files and edits the text inside them, processing a whole drawing set at once and packaging the result as a single download — removing the manual renaming pass across large issues.
